labeler_notes: do not include any MEDICATIONS on admission; in the HOSPITAL COURSE scan for the section until discharge portion is mentioned, then look for medications. Statuses unknown: enalapril is a home med but no ‘continue’ wording; cipro was ‘switched over’ in hospital. Macrodantin/hydralazine on admission list only, not labeled. Lasix/Fortaz in-hospital only. If a medication appears on both the admission list and the discharge medication list, put its status as 'continued'. Otherwise if a medication only appears in the discharge section but not the admission section, put status 'new'. However if there's no admission list nor explicit wording saying a discharge medication is new, just put 'unknown' to be safe.
